attackers_goals: Discover valid accounts to gain credentials.
description: Multiple non-existing accounts failed to remotely log in to a host in a short period of time. This may indicate an attacker is trying to remotely enumerate accounts.
investigative_actions: Check if the login attempts were part of a legitimate misunderstanding of the system or part of an attack.
